EVIDENCE_GROUNDED: No — the axes document concerns about VP Duterte's specific confidential funds and general institutional oversight weaknesses, but don't provide evidence of discovered "layers of selective enforcement" or multiple Philippine accountability cases being analyzed.

COUNTER_ARGUMENT: You're reframing slow progress on your writing projects as discovery of deep institutional patterns, when the axes suggest you've focused primarily on one high-profile case (Duterte funds) rather than the systematic comparative analysis "layers" implies.

OVERCLAIM: Yes — "each case reveals another layer" suggests multiple completed case analyses revealing cumulative patterns, but the evidence shows concern about one prominent scandal plus general institutional skepticism, not documented multi-case investigation.

AXIS_MATCH: Partially — the skepticism toward institutional accountability aligns with the "Trust in Political Institutions" axis (-0.509), but the post implies active research uncovering patterns rather than the axes' focus on demanding transparency in a specific ongoing scandal.
